notes: An action slot holding a macro keeps an id only, never the macro's name or body. With no subtype the id is taken to be the macro index [verify], and which macro of macros-cache.txt an index names is not known [verify]. The candidate numbering gives account macros 1 to 120 and character macros from 121: the offset of 120 is Retail's, from memory [verify]; counting the records in each file's order is this tool's assumption [verify]. Every slot given here is a candidate only. If macros-cache.txt is older than the record, positions in it, and so every candidate here, may be off.

A key reaches an action slot through the default UI's action buttons: button n of the bar showing page p is slot (p - 1) x 12 + n [verify]. The main bar is read at page 1 only, the page shown with no form, stance or stealth active; the pages shown by paging, a form, stance or stealth, or a possess, override or vehicle bar [verify], the pet and stance bars and an addon's buttons are not followed.
Without a bindings record only the files' lines are listed; a file may leave out keys at the client's defaults [verify], so keys not listed may still be bound.

Length: counted in characters and UTF-8 bytes of the body lines joined by LF, with no final line break; over 255 characters is a finding, over 255 bytes only is cannot judge; the client's limit is 255, and whether it counts characters or bytes is [verify].

macros-cache.txt is what the client last wrote; the server can replace it at login when macro sync is on. In a real capture (docs/LAB_FORMATS.md, 2026-10-16) a macro made in a finished session was missing from it (whether the client rewrites it at logout is [verify]), so a macro may be missing here, or still listed after you deleted it.

The spellbook and action bars are the lab-addon's record as of its last save (logout or /reload), not the session in progress. It reads the player's spellbook only, so an item, a pet, mount or toy spell after /cast reads as not in the spellbook.
